name: Head of Targorr
summary: In the Stormwind Stockade, nobles have halted Targorr's execution. The orc once served Gath'Ilzogg in the Redridge Mountains, and Guard Berton in Lakeshire now demands proof of his death.

sections.title: A Delayed Execution
sections.body: Targorr the Dread was the Blackrock clan warlord Gath'Ilzogg's feared executioner in Redridge. Before his capture, he tortured and slaughtered defenders of the Kingdom of Stormwind. Sentenced to die in the Stormwind Stockade, he was spared when Stormwind nobles intervened. Guardsmen like Berton suspect foul play and corruption in the capital.

sections.title: Frontier Justice
sections.body: Guard Berton fears Targorr could become a political pawn or arrange an escape. So he hires an outside champion to enter the volatile prison and finish what the courts delayed. Taking Targorr's head bypasses the stalled legal system. It also gives closure to grieving families and Lakeshire's besieged defenders, who suffered under the executioner's blades.

faq.answer: Targorr the Dread was an infamous orc executioner of the Blackrock clan in Redridge. Under the warlord Gath'Ilzogg, he tortured and executed captured Stormwind soldiers and defenders.

faq.q: Why was Targorr kept alive in the Stockade?
faq.answer: Stormwind nobles mysteriously halted Targorr's death sentence through bureaucratic intervention. Lakeshire guards suspect political foul play and corruption, and fear he is being kept as a bargaining chip.

Guard Berton, stationed outside the Lakeshire Inn, wants Targorr's severed head. After seeing the carnage Targorr caused in the Redridge Mountains, Berton seeks proof the executioner can never be freed.
Targorr the Dread is held in the Stormwind Stockade, behind iron bars in the central cell blocks with rioting inmates.

angles.text: For Alliance champions defending Redridge, Targorr's death avenges the slaughtered defenders of Lakeshire and bypasses corrupt noble bureaucracy in Stormwind.
As a human, you may share the soldiers' and town guards' grudge against Targorr for torturing captured Kingdom troops during the Blackrock offensive.
